text: “木”字单独是一棵树，两个“木”并排是“林”。三个“木”叠在一起是哪个字？
gloss: One 木 is a tree, two make 林 (grove); three stacked make which character? — 森 (forest); 磊 is three stones, 焱 three fires, 淼 three waters.

text: “一刻钟”是15分钟，那么“三刻钟”是多少分钟？
gloss: "One quarter-hour (刻) is 15 minutes", so how long is 三刻钟? — 45 minutes: three times 15.

text: “妈、麻、马、骂”依次读一声、二声、三声、四声。其中读第三声的是哪个字？
gloss: Mā, má, mǎ, mà read in tones 1 to 4 in order; which is the third tone? — 马 (mǎ).

text: 下面哪个词里的“行”，读作 háng？
gloss: Which word reads 行 as háng rather than xíng? — 银行 (bank); in 行走, 行李 and 步行 it is xíng.

text: “年年有余”是春节的吉祥话，借的是谐音。年夜饭上取这个彩头的是哪道菜？
gloss: A pun on 余 (surplus) and 鱼 (fish), both yú: which New Year dish carries the wish "may every year have a surplus"? — Fish; 年糕 puns on "higher every year" (年年高), not "surplus".

text: 北方冬天街头常见的冰糖葫芦，最传统的主料是什么？
gloss: What is the most traditional fruit on a candied tanghulu skewer in northern winters? — Hawthorn berries (山楂).

text: 传说每年农历七月初七，喜鹊搭起鹊桥，让牛郎与谁相会？
gloss: On the seventh night of the seventh lunar month magpies build a bridge for the Cowherd to meet whom? — The Weaver Girl (织女).

text: 北京的故宫，在明清两代被称作什么？
gloss: What was Beijing's Palace Museum called in the Ming and Qing dynasties? — The Forbidden City (紫禁城); the others are other Beijing imperial sites.

text: 素有“天府之国”美称的是哪个省？
gloss: Which province is called the "Land of Abundance" (天府之国)? — Sichuan, from the fertile Chengdu Plain.

text: 古装剧里，皇帝自称什么？
gloss: In costume dramas what does the emperor call himself? — 朕; 本宫 is a consort, 哀家 the dowager, 本王 a prince.

text: 中医“望闻问切”里的“切”，指的是医生做什么？
gloss: In the four diagnostic methods of Chinese medicine (look, listen/smell, ask, feel), what does 切 mean? — Feeling the pulse; 望 is looking (e.g. the tongue), 闻 listening and smelling, 问 asking.

text: 在简谱里，数字“1、2、3”分别唱作do、re、mi，照这个顺序往下数，数字“6”唱作什么？
gloss: In numbered notation 1 to 7 are do re mi fa sol la si; how is 6 sung? — la, the sixth in the list.

text: 文房四宝里的“砚”，是用来做什么的？
gloss: In the Four Treasures of the Study, what is the inkstone (砚) for? — Grinding ink; paperweights press paper and brush washers clean brushes.

text: 京剧的“生、旦、净、丑”四大行当里，主要扮演女性角色的是哪一个？
gloss: Which of the four Peking opera role types mainly plays women? — 旦 (dan).

text: 手机“云盘”里的照片，实际保存在哪里？
gloss: Where are photos in a phone's "cloud drive" actually stored? — On servers on the internet, not a literal cloud or satellite.

text: 一杯拿铁咖啡里，除了咖啡，加得最多的是什么？
gloss: Besides coffee, what is the main ingredient of a latte? — Steamed milk.

text: 冬天用湿手去摸冷冻室里的冰块，手会被粘住。这是因为手上的水发生了什么变化？
gloss: Why does a wet hand stick to ice from the freezer? — The water on the skin freezes, bonding the hand to the ice.

text: 夏天开空调，出风口最好朝上吹，这是因为冷空气会怎样？
gloss: Why should the air conditioner blow upward in summer? — Cold air is denser and sinks, so it spreads through the room.

text: 用手碰一碰含羞草的叶子，叶子会怎样？
gloss: What happens when you touch a mimosa (sensitive plant) leaf? — It folds closed.

text: 壁虎遇到危险时，会主动甩掉什么来脱身？
gloss: What does a gecko drop to escape a predator? — Its tail, which later regrows.

text: 哆啦A梦能从肚子前面的哪里取出各种神奇道具？
gloss: Where does Doraemon pull his gadgets from? — His four-dimensional pocket.

text: 视频清晰度里常说的“4K”，指的是画面的什么更高？
gloss: What does "4K" refer to in video quality? — Resolution (about 4000 pixels across).

text: 《俄罗斯方块》里，每一块下落的方块都是由几个小方格拼成的？
gloss: How many small squares make up each falling piece in Tetris? — Four (the tetrominoes).

text: 足球比赛中，球整体越过边线出界后，怎样把球重新发回场内？
gloss: How is a football put back into play after it crosses the touchline? — A two-handed throw-in.

text: 天气预报说“降水概率90%”，最接近什么意思？
options: 一天里有90%的时间在下雨
gloss: What does "90% chance of precipitation" mean? — Rain is very likely; it says nothing about intensity, amount or duration (the common trap).

text: 北京的七月正值盛夏，同一时间，澳大利亚的悉尼是什么季节？
gloss: It is high summer in Beijing in July; what season is it in Sydney? — Winter: the southern hemisphere's seasons are reversed.

text: 做寿司卷时，外面包着米饭的那层黑色薄片叫什么？
gloss: What is the thin black sheet wrapped around sushi rice? — Nori (海苔), dried seaweed.

text: 衣服标签上的“XL”表示什么尺码？
gloss: What size does "XL" on a clothing label mean? — Extra large (加大号).

text: “朝三暮四”的故事里，猴子嫌早上三个晚上四个太少，改成早四晚三就高兴了。一天一共几个栗子？
gloss: In the "three in the morning, four at night" story, the monkeys were angry, then happy with four and three. How many chestnuts a day? — Seven either way.

text: 传说天上原有十个太阳，后羿射日之后，留给人间的有几个？
gloss: In the legend there were ten suns; after Hou Yi's arrows how many were left? — One (nine shot down).

text: 《红楼梦》里，住在大观园潇湘馆、爱葬花的是谁？
gloss: Who lives in the Xiaoxiang Lodge of the Grand View Garden and buries fallen blossoms? — Lin Daiyu.

text: 举世闻名的兵马俑坑，位于哪座城市附近？
gloss: Near which city are the famous Terracotta Army pits? — Xi'an.

text: 跨越伶仃洋的港珠澳大桥，名字里的“珠”指的是哪座城市？
gloss: Which city does the "Zhu" in the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge stand for? — Zhuhai.

text: 姚明在美国职业篮球联赛（NBA）里，效力的是哪支球队？
gloss: Which NBA team did Yao Ming play for? — The Houston Rockets, his whole NBA career.

text: 鲨鱼的整副骨架，是由什么构成的？
gloss: What is a shark's skeleton made of? — Cartilage, not bone.

text: 夏天，一杯冰饮的外壁会挂满水珠。这些水是从哪里来的？
gloss: Where does the water on a cold glass come from? — Water vapour in the air condenses on the cold surface; glass does not leak.

text: 意大利水城威尼斯，最有代表性的传统小船叫什么？
gloss: What is Venice's emblematic traditional boat? — The gondola (贡多拉); 乌篷船 is Shaoxing's.

text: 男高音帕瓦罗蒂与多明戈、卡雷拉斯合称“三大男高音”，他来自哪个国家？
gloss: Pavarotti, one of the Three Tenors, was from which country? — Italy; Domingo and Carreras were Spanish.

text: 哪部宫崎骏动画里，女孩的父母因为贪吃变成了猪？
gloss: Which Miyazaki film has a girl's parents turned into pigs after gorging? — Spirited Away.

text: 手机网络“5G”里的“G”，指的是英文的哪个词？
gloss: What does the G in 5G stand for? — Generation (the fifth generation of mobile networks).

text: 川菜里让人舌头发“麻”的，主要来自哪种调料？
gloss: Which spice gives Sichuan food its numbing "ma" feeling? — Sichuan pepper (花椒); chili gives the heat.

text: 农历九月初九重阳节，人们自古有什么习俗？
gloss: What is the traditional custom on the Double Ninth Festival? — Climbing high (登高); the others belong to other festivals.

text: 成语“半斤八两”，是因为旧时一斤等于多少两？
gloss: The idiom 半斤八两 ("half a jin, eight liang") works because the old jin was how many liang? — 16, so half a jin is 8 liang, i.e. equal.

text: “印象派”这个名称，来自莫奈的哪一幅画？
gloss: Which Monet painting gave Impressionism its name? — Impression, Sunrise (1874); Luncheon on the Grass is by Manet.

text: 声音在下面哪种物质中传播得最快？
gloss: In which material does sound travel fastest? — Steel; faster in solids than in water, and slowest in air.

text: 黄河发源于青海，奔流数千千米，最终注入哪片海？
gloss: Into which sea does the Yellow River finally flow? — The Bohai Sea, often confused with the Yellow Sea.

text: “横眉冷对千夫指，俯首甘为孺子牛”出自谁之手？
gloss: Who wrote "Fierce-browed I coolly face a thousand pointing fingers; head bowed I serve like an ox for children"? — Lu Xun (the poem 自嘲).

text: 1953年提出DNA双螺旋结构模型的，是哪两位科学家？
gloss: Which two scientists proposed the DNA double helix in 1953? — Watson and Crick.

text: 玄奘西行取经归来后，口述、由弟子辩机整理的西域游记是哪一部？
gloss: Which travelogue did Xuanzang dictate and his disciple Bianji compile? — Great Tang Records on the Western Regions; 佛国记 is Faxian's.

text: 古希腊学者利用同一时刻两地日影的差异，最早较准确地算出了地球的周长。他是谁？
gloss: Which Greek scholar first estimated the Earth's circumference from shadow angles at two places? — Eratosthenes.
